'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Sam Marlow DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sam Marlow]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Crapola'''. L1 written SYCFA / 7-Side. L37 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer. L38 Visage is the Death Star II starship. L53 written V-3PO → U-3PO.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' Hari Seldon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
